# Vouchins

> A verified professional network and member marketplace where access is confirmed through corporate email verification.

Vouchins connects verified working professionals to discover housing, find flatmates, request employee referrals, and exchange peer recommendations with greater accountability and trust.

## Core Pages

- [Homepage](https://www.vouchins.com/): Official homepage and platform overview
- [About Vouchins](https://www.vouchins.com/about): Mission, trust framework, and company vision
- [How It Works](https://www.vouchins.com/how-it-works): Work email verification, trust signals, and peer vouches
- [Community Safety](https://www.vouchins.com/safety): Safety policies and member guidelines
- [Blog](https://www.vouchins.com/blog): Professional networking articles, market guides, and platform updates
- [Flatmates in Hyderabad](https://www.vouchins.com/flatmates-in-hyderabad): Dedicated directory for finding verified flatmates in Hyderabad
- [Business Solutions](https://www.vouchins.com/business): Employer solutions and corporate partnerships
- [Contact Support](https://www.vouchins.com/contact): Customer support and team communication channels
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.vouchins.com/privacy): Data privacy policies and protection
- [Terms of Service](https://www.vouchins.com/terms): Platform user agreements and guidelines
